Eldanna grows along saltwater shores and coastlines in cold regions, particularly northern Endor. Its leaves are gathered in these coastal habitats and are moderately difficult to find.

Brewed as an infusion or decoction, the leaves provide a level 9 antidote to reduction poisons. Eldanna also has a more unusual property: it can reverse the curse known as “Ugliness of Orn”. These are distinct uses of the same prepared herb.
